title: How the Mizaj test works
caption:
How does the Mizaj test work? Quickly:

48 questions give you your type: how you recharge, take in the world, decide and plan. 24 more give you your element: Air, Fire, Water or Earth. Together they make your card in the Mizaj Deck.

It's a mirror, not a prophecy, and not a verdict on anyone's marriage. No sign-up, no data selling, in English or Urdu.

Send it to someone who's been 'meaning to do a personality test'.

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
